title: Production Monitoring, Logging, and Scaling
objectives: Set up production monitoring, logging, and performance optimisation.
theory_markdown:
Production monitoring: application performance (APM), error tracking, uptime monitoring, database performance. Tools: Sentry (errors), LogRocket (session replay), UptimeRobot (uptime), New Relic/Datadog (APM — free tiers).

Logging: structured JSON logs, log levels, log aggregation (Papertrail, Logtail), correlation IDs. Alerting: Slack/email notifications for errors, performance degradation, and uptime issues.

code_walkthrough.explanation: `/health` reports service status for load balancers and orchestrators. Metrics middleware tracks request counts, status codes, and response times. P95 latency is a key performance indicator. The health endpoint returns 503 when degraded, causing load balancers to route traffic away.

ai_tool_spotlight.description: Use **UptimeRobot** (free, 50 monitors), **Sentry** (free tier, 5K errors/month), **Better Stack** (free tier for logging and uptime).
